candidates.title: Visual Pet Style Selection Grid
candidates.change: Rebuild the pet selection screen into an interactive visual grid layout with clear style previews.
candidates.why: Adoption stage has a steep drop-off of 37.4% and support tickets note user confusion and custom pet generation failures.

guard.reason: Redesigns pet choice screen into a grid while preserving choice functionality inside onboarding.

candidates.score_note: Adoption step has the largest drop-off (37.4%) and support emails confirm user confusion and pet generation issues; rebuilding requires a app release.

candidates.title: Custom Pet Photo Preview Verification Screen
candidates.change: Insert a photo preview and validation screen right after photo upload to ensure image quality before starting pet generation.
candidates.why: Support mails report that custom pet generation fails or looks wrong, driving adoption drop-offs.

new_photo_preview.headline: Preview Your Custom Pet Source
new_photo_preview.body: Ensure lighting is clear and your pet's face is fully visible before proceeding.

guard.reason: Adds a valid preview step inside onboarding without removing or skipping required steps.

candidates.score_note: Targeted fix for pet generation failures highlighted in support emails and adoption drop-off, but requires inserting a new screen.

candidates.title: Generation Progress Time Estimate Display
candidates.change: Display dynamic time remaining estimates and animated progress metrics on the waiting screen while pet assets render.
candidates.why: The waiting step has a high median wait time of 201s and mean of 2336s, leading users to abandon the app while waiting.

waiting.hint: Your pet is being crafted. This usually takes around 2-3 minutes.

guard.reason: Adds progress and time estimate metrics to waiting screen during actual asset generation.

candidates.score_note: Very high average wait time (2336s) causes drop-off; displaying progress metrics helps retain waiting users.

candidates.title: Account Sync Benefits and Recovery Info
candidates.change: Add clear guidance on the sign-in screen highlighting cloud backup and pet persistence across re-installs.
candidates.why: 8 support emails were received about pets missing or reset after signing in again.

sign_in.hint: Signing in backs up your pet traits so you never lose your desktop companion on restart or sign-in.

guard.reason: Adds informative sign-in guidance without touching pricing or breaking rules.

candidates.score_note: Addresses 8 support emails regarding account sync issues via a low-cost copy change on sign_in.

candidates.title: Desktop Interaction Modes Spotlight Guide
candidates.change: Redesign the home introduction screen into a spotlight card layout detailing desktop controls, hiding mechanisms, and pet chat.
candidates.why: Finish step drop-off is 35.2%, and support receives multiple queries on how to control, hide, or talk to pets.

home_welcome.text: Right-click to open pet controls, drag to move, or click the tray icon to hide/show.

guard.reason: 'home_intro.replace.home_welcome[0]': a tip_carousel cannot do the home_welcome job (use ['animation', 'button', 'checklist', 'image', 'mascot', 'text'])

candidates.title: Split Layout Path Option Cards
candidates.change: Format the path choice screen into a clear split-column layout contrasting ready-made pets with custom photo generation.
candidates.why: Choose path takes a mean time of 514s, indicating user uncertainty when selecting their onboarding route.

guard.reason: Updates path selection layout while preserving path choices.

candidates.score_note: High mean completion time (514s) indicates confusion on choose_path step; layout update helps clarify options.

candidates.title: Interactive Pet Desktop Spawn Showcase Flow
candidates.change: Add an interactive desktop spawn test screen to verify pet desktop placement and basic interaction prior to completing onboarding.
candidates.why: Support tickets highlight cases where pets fail to show up on the desktop or users cannot figure out basic controls.

new_spawn_preview.headline: Meet Your Pet on Your Desktop!
new_spawn_preview.body: Your pet has landed on your screen. Try dragging your pet or right-clicking to view options.

guard.reason: Adds a new interaction preview screen following home_intro within onboarding.

candidates.score_note: Finish step drops 35.2% of users and support tickets report desktop spawn failures; new showcase flow requires dev release.

candidates.title: Adopt First Sign In Later Onboarding Flow
candidates.change: Shift account sign-in after pet adoption choices so users engage with pet creation before creating an account.
candidates.why: Sign-in currently drops 25.3% of users at step 2; deferring auth allows users to build investment in their chosen pet.

guard.reason: Reorders sign-in step after waiting, which is explicitly allowed by rule 4.

candidates.score_note: Deferring auth reduces early 25.3% drop-off at sign-in step by building user intent first, but requires flow restructuring.

candidates.title: Desktop Ready Audio Completion Cue
candidates.change: Play a gentle notification chime when pet creation finishes so users who backgrounded the app know their pet is ready.
candidates.why: Mean wait time is over 38 minutes (2336s), suggesting users switch windows and forget about onboarding.

guard.reason: Adds an audio completion cue to the waiting screen within onboarding.

candidates.score_note: Mean wait time of over 38 minutes suggests app backgrounding; audio notification helps re-engage returning users.

candidates.title: Onboarding Story Value Proposition Headline
candidates.change: Update the initial story welcome screen headline and body text to highlight quick 2-minute setup and pet desktop features.
candidates.why: Step 1 drop-off is 19.6% with high mean completion time (514s), requiring clearer initial motivation.

story.headline: Your New AI Desktop Companion Awaits
story.body: Adopt or create a custom virtual pet that lives right on your desktop in under 2 minutes.

guard.reason: Updates story copy to introduce the pet without introducing pricing or dark patterns.

candidates.score_note: Simple copy change to clarify value proposition on the first step; low cost config update.

Account Sync Benefits and Recovery Info
